items.text: AP/Washington Times (June 7, 4:12 PM ET): In an NBC 'Meet the Press' interview aired Sunday, Trump dismissed the idea that launching the Iran war betrayed his 'No new wars' campaign message: 'First of all, I didn't guarantee no war. Why would I have built the strongest military in the world?' Trump also defended plans for the scrapped $1.8 billion anti-weaponization fund and made baseless claims about California primary fraud. On Iran: Trump criticised Israel's strikes on Beirut, urged Netanyahu to avoid retaliatory action against Iran, while calling on Tehran to resume negotiations. This de-escalation signal from Trump — urging both sides to stand down — is the single positive in an otherwise heavily negative Monday open. If Trump's call is heeded by both Netanyahu and Iran, Brent could ease from Monday's spike.

War-period fuel price trajectory: Petrol now ₹111.21/L (up from ~Rs95 pre-war, +Rs16/L total), Diesel ₹97.83/L (up from ~Rs86 pre-war, +Rs12/L total), LPG ₹941.50/cylinder (up from ~Rs853 pre-war, +Rs88/cylinder total). Rupee at ₹95.36/USD. At Monday Brent rising above $93, OMC diesel under-recovery now approximately Rs30-35/L. A fourth fuel hike becomes likely if Brent stays above Rs95+ for more than 2-3 weeks. India's 1.4 billion people are absorbing the full cost of this conflict at the pump and the kitchen. PM Modi's conservation appeal (avoid gold, WFH, public transport) is now a structural reality.

nukes.name: Bushehr ☢️
nukes.info: IAEA: strikes 250ft from operating reactor. Rosatom evacuated 200 staff. Reactor operational. IAEA cannot access. Minor explosions in Tehran suggest continuing instability. Ceasefire holding but Iran reconstituting missile bases — escalation risk if Apr 21 ceasefire lapses.

nukes.name: Natanz
nukes.info: MAIN enrichment plant 75% damaged. R&D 95% destroyed. Nuclear sticking point — Vance offered 20-yr moratorium, Iran said 3-5 yrs, both rejected. IAEA: Iran has ~1,000 lbs (440kg+) HEU = enough for ~11 nuclear weapons. Fox News: 'all ingredients of a deal' — suggests nuclear gap may be bridgeable.

nukes.name: Isfahan
nukes.info: CRITICAL: IAEA Grossi: MAJORITY of Iran's ~440kg of 60% HEU in deeply buried tunnel complex here. US demanded retrieval at Islamabad; Iran agreed only to 'monitored down-blending' — rejected by US. UCF conversion 90% destroyed above-ground. New underground enrichment facility — IAEA never inspected.

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Fordow built into mountain near Qom. Only 30% damaged despite GBU-57 MOPs. Core enrichment capability potentially intact. US demanded full dismantlement; Iran refused at Islamabad. Greatest long-term proliferation risk. Iran reconstituting missile cities during ceasefire — same pattern expected here.

nukes.name: Arak (IR-40)
nukes.info: Heavy water reactor capable of producing weapons-grade plutonium. Struck in early war waves. Satellite imagery showing Iran reconstituting missile cities during ceasefire — Arak likely same pattern. Second potential weapons path alongside uranium enrichment.

assessment.headline: DAY 100 CENTENARY, 8:45AM MON: IRAN FIRED MISSILES AT ISRAEL OVERNIGHT — ALL INTERCEPTED. WTI +3.41% TO $93.63 MONDAY. GIFT NIFTY -273 PTS. KOSPI -9%. NIKKEI -4.14%. assessment.body:
Monday 8:45 AM IST. Day 100. The war's centenary. The most negative Monday open of the conflict.

IRAN FIRED MISSILES AT ISRAEL OVERNIGHT
Direct Iran→Israel strike during ceasefire period — structurally new.
All intercepted by Israeli military. No casualties.
Fired in response to Israeli strikes on Beirut.
Iran FM Araghchi's Lebanon linkage is now operational reality, not rhetoric.
Iran will not sign an MOU while Israeli forces are in Lebanon and striking Beirut.

TRUMP'S DUAL DE-ESCALATION PUSH
Criticised Israel's strikes on Beirut.
Urged Netanyahu NOT to retaliate against Iran.
Called on Iran to resume negotiations.
This is Trump trying to keep the deal alive by preventing a spiral.
NBC 'Meet the Press': 'I didn't guarantee no war.'
The deal is still Trump's priority — but Iran-Israel front makes it harder.

MARKET IMPACT — THE WORST MONDAY OPEN OF THE CONFLICT

The Iran-Israel missile exchange has fundamentally changed the deal dynamic.
Iran will not sign until Lebanon is resolved.
Lebanon will not resolve until Hezbollah stands down.
Hezbollah will not stand down until Israel withdraws.
Israel will not withdraw unless forced by the US.
Trump is trying to force that — but Netanyahu is resisting.
